{{Quote|Eighty-seven hours ago, the Fifth Naval Patrol Group was attacked. All hands were lost&mdash;1,239 servicemen total.|Moff Jiak|<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Immediate Vengeance|Corellia}}</ref>}}
The '''Fifth Naval Patrol Group''' was a division of the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the [[Galactic War]], the entire patrol group was wiped out by its own [[Droid/Legends|droids]] operating under [[Directive 7]]; the Empire found the corpses of all 1,239 servicemen orbiting in perfect rings around the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Aduba (star)|Aduba]].
